root.name: ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー

companies.name: カッティング・エッジ・グループ

relations.text: 2025年1月に音楽カタログの70%の持分を同社との合弁会社に拠出した
relations.text_en: In January 2025, WBD contributed a 70% interest in its music catalog to a joint venture with Cutting Edge Group

source.label: Warner Bros. Discovery 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.label_en: Warner Bros. Discovery 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: In January 2025, we contributed a 70% interest in our music catalog to a joint venture with Cutting Edge Group in exchange for net proceeds of $601 million.

companies.name: ウォルト・ディズニー

relations.text: ESPN(ディズニーの子会社)とFoxとともに、スポーツ配信サービスVenu Sportsの合弁会社設立を発表した
relations.text_en: WBD announced a joint venture with ESPN, a Disney subsidiary, and Fox to form Venu Sports

source.label: Warner Bros. Discovery 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.label_en: Warner Bros. Discovery 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: On February 6, 2024, the Company announced that it would enter into a joint venture with ESPN, a subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company (“Disney”), and Fox Corporation (“Fox”) to form Venu Sports, a sports-centric streaming service in the United States.

relations.text: ESPNおよびディズニーとともに、Venu Sportsの合弁会社設立を発表した
relations.text_en: WBD announced a joint venture with ESPN, Disney and Fox to form Venu Sports

source.label: Warner Bros. Discovery 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.label_en: Warner Bros. Discovery 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: On February 6, 2024, the Company announced that it would enter into a joint venture with ESPN, a subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company (“Disney”), and Fox Corporation (“Fox”) to form Venu Sports, a sports-centric streaming service in the United States.

companies.name: AT&T(エーティーアンドティー)

relations.text: ワーナーメディア合併に伴い、AT&Tと税務事項契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In connection with the WarnerMedia Merger, WBD entered into a tax matters agreement with AT&T

source.label: Warner Bros. Discovery 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.label_en: Warner Bros. Discovery 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025)
source.quote: In connection with the WarnerMedia Merger, the Company entered into a tax matters agreement (“TMA”) with AT&T.
